entities.summary: Hungary was represented at the Eurovision Song Contest 2011 with the song "What About My Dreams?" written by Viktor Rakonczai, Gergő Rácz, Johnny K. Palmer and Péter Geszti. The song was performed by Kati Wolf. Songwriters Viktor Rakonczai and Gergő Rácz represented Hungary in the Eurovision Song Contest 1997 as part of the boy band V.I.P., placing twelfth in the competition with the song "Miért kell, hogy elmenj?". In December 2010, the Hungarian public broadcaster Magyar Televízió (MTV) announced that they would be returning to the Eurovision Song Contest after a one-year absence following their withdrawal in 2010 due to financial difficulties.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The song 'What About My Dreams?' represented Hungary at Eurovision in 2011 and marked their return to the contest after a one-year absence, highlighting the country's cultural resilience and public broadcaster's efforts to revive its presence.
